themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, often involving complex workflows, decision-making, and tool utilization.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, notes, or transcripts into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated users or content that mimics human behavior and can be used for testing or research.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of the research process.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores AI applications in automating, enhancing, or conducting usability tests for products and services.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on research studies and findings related to the behavior, impact, and capabilities of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including concerns about displacement and new opportunities.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI's role in understanding design trends, user preferences, and the creative process, as well as AI's impact on design tools.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Details how AI is being used to conduct and analyze qualitative data, such as interviews and open-ended feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
